additional_info.body:
Dear Jason Stonier,
We would like to inform you that your recent charging session ended due to a normal shutdown — specifically, charging was stopped after a timeout during the stop charge phase.
This means the system initiated the session termination process, but the expected stop confirmation did not occur within the allowed timeframe, resulting in an automatic timeout and session closure.
Please let us know if you experienced any unusual behavior during the session or if you have any further questions or concerns
With best regards,

Ankita
